import sys, z3

def z3_g(a, b, x):
    t = a + b + z3.BitVecVal(x, 8)
    return z3.RotateLeft(t, 2)

def z3_f(v):
    x0 = z3.Extract(7, 0, v)
    x1 = z3.Extract(15, 8, v)
    x2 = z3.Extract(23, 16, v)
    x3 = z3.Extract(31, 24, v)
    y2 = z3_g(x3 ^ x2, x1 ^ x0, 1)
    y3 = z3_g(x3, y2, 0)
    y1 = z3_g(x1 ^ x0, y2, 0)
    y0 = z3_g(x0, y1, 1)
    return z3.Concat(y3, y2, y1, y0)

def f(v):
    x = [(v >> (8*i)) & 0xff for i in range(4)]
    def g(a,b,x):
        t = (a+b+x) & 0xff
        return ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xff
    y = [0]*4
    y[2] = g(x[3]^x[2], x[1]^x[0], 1)
    y[3] = g(x[3], y[2], 0)
    y[1] = g(x[1]^x[0], y[2], 0)
    y[0] = g(x[0], y[1], 1)
    return y[0] | (y[1]<<8) | (y[2]<<16) | (y[3]<<24)

pairs = []
for line in open('/app/pairs.txt'):
    a, b = line.split()
    pairs.append((int(a), int(b)))

n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3

K = [z3.BitVec(f'K{i}', 32) for i in range(4)]
s = z3.Solver()
for p, c in pairs[:n]:
    L0 = p >> 32
    R0 = p & 0xffffffff
    A0 = z3.BitVecVal(L0, 32)
    B0 = z3.BitVecVal(R0 ^ L0, 32)
    high = c >> 32
    low = c & 0xffffffff
    B4 = z3.BitVecVal(high, 32)
    B3 = z3.BitVecVal(high ^ low, 32)
    B1 = A0 ^ z3_f(B0 ^ K[0])
    B2 = B0 ^ z3_f(B1 ^ K[1])
    s.add(B3 == B1 ^ z3_f(B2 ^ K[2]))
    s.add(B4 == B2 ^ z3_f(B3 ^ K[3]))

s.set('timeout', 300000)
r = s.check()
print(r)
if r == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    ks = [m[K[i]].as_long() for i in range(4)]
    print([hex(k) for k in ks])
    # verify with python implementation on all pairs
    def enc(pt, ks):

        R = pt & 0xffffffff
        R ^= L
        for rnd in range(4):
            mixed = f(R ^ ks[rnd])
            R, L = L ^ mixed, R

    ok = all(enc(p, ks) == c for p, c in pairs)
    print('all pairs verified:', ok)
